concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-platforms-transfer-transactions-track-api]] — 2026-09-15 Transfers API transaction-query guide for platform/account-holder/balance-account scope, internal/external signed rows, pending/booked dates and pagination; sample identifiers conflict and rows are not bank-receipt proof.
warnings: The guide also covers Issuing and Payouts integrations. Test response IDs/currencies and internal-leg identifiers are inconsistent, and example request code is not production-ready; use observed rows rather than sample joins. Booked payout debit does not prove beneficiary bank receipt.
